final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT "ANA Pattern" AS pattern, AVG("aCL IgG") AS avg_igg FROM Examination WHERE "ANA Pattern" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("ANA Pattern") <> '' GROUP BY "ANA Pattern"), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT pattern, avg_igg, avg_igg - mean_avg AS above_mean FROM group_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE avg_igg > mean_avg) SELECT pattern, avg_igg, above_mean, avg_igg - AVG(avg_igg) OVER () AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept
